data.headline: Air is Poor today; keep Aarav indoors until W1
data.summary: PM2.5 is high this evening and lowest between 3 and 4 pm tomorrow (W1).

routine.title: Move Aarav's play time to W1
routine.why: PM2.5 in W1 is lower than now by 44%, and Aarav has asthma.
routine.impact: Less fine-particle exposure for Aarav during play.

indoor.title: Keep windows closed this evening
indoor.why: Outdoor PM2.5 is in the Poor band until tomorrow afternoon.
indoor.impact: Keeps indoor air cleaner without a purifier.

impact.title: Carpool the school run
impact.health: Fewer car trips also mean less traffic smoke near school.
impact.emissions: Carpooling with 2 people would cut about 2.1 kg CO₂ a week.

memberNotes.note: Keep his reliever inhaler at hand.

data.seekCareIf: Wheezing that does not ease with the reliever, or breathlessness at rest.
